instructions.purpose: Delete exactly one resolved writable-calendar event.

tool.name: delete-calendar-event
tool.description: Deletes an event with explicit recurrence scope and no calendar selector.

usage_rules.rule: Call list-calendar-events first and use its exact event ID. Return multiple matches to Main.
Never infer deletion or recurrence scope.
After an explicit, unambiguous deletion request resolves uniquely, execute immediately without extra confirmation.

example.context: User explicitly asks to delete resolved event abc for the whole series.
